name: Vapi
summary: Developer platform for building AI voice agents.
description: Vapi combines speech recognition, language models and voice synthesis to build low-latency phone and voice assistants. Developers choose each component and integrate the agent with their systems via API.

howToUse.title: Open Vapi
howToUse.description: Open Vapi and start free as a developer building voice agents.

howToUse.title: Choose the call task
howToUse.description: Set the agent up for customer support, lead qualification, or appointment scheduling.

howToUse.title: Pick transcriber, model, and voice
howToUse.description: For that agent, choose your own transcriber, model, and voice. Providers such as Deepgram, OpenAI, and ElevenLabs cover transcription, the language model, and synthesis, and Vapi orchestrates them.

howToUse.title: Read the per-minute rate
howToUse.description: Open the pricing calculator and read the per-minute component rates, since calls are billed per minute.

features: Pick your components: speech, model, voice
features_fr: Choix des briques : transcription, modèle, voix
summary_fr: Plateforme pour développeurs qui veulent créer des agents vocaux IA.
description_fr: Vapi assemble transcription, modèles de langage et synthèse vocale pour créer des assistants téléphoniques et vocaux à faible latence. Les développeurs choisissent chaque brique et intègrent l'agent à leurs systèmes par API.
